summary: The PHONE keeps RINGING in the shop until Trinity tells Neo to answer it. Neo picks up the PHONE on a CLICK, but there is no signal, only silence. Trinity asks what happened and Neo says he doesn't know, that it just went dead. Trinity listens to the dead line and takes out the cellular.

what_changes.before: Holding the ringing PHONE, waiting to be told to answer.
what_changes.after: Has answered the PHONE, but the line is dead with no signal.
what_changes.evidence: Neo answers the PHONE when there is a CLICK. There is no signal. Nothing but silence.

what_changes.before: Waiting on the ringing line after Neo picks up.
what_changes.after: Learning the line is dead and taking out the cellular to act.
what_changes.evidence: Trinity listens to the dead line and takes out the cellular.

event_hint.one_line: The crew's phone exit line goes dead, cutting off their escape.

uncertain: Whether the line went dead because of Cypher's attack on the Main Deck or for another reason.

minds.wants: To complete the exit cleanly — to do the one thing he's been told to do and get them both out.
minds.feels: A sudden drop into wrongness. He has just been initiated into the crew, and the first independent action he takes produces not connection but dead silence — an outcome he cannot interpret and cannot fix.
minds.shows: Flat report: 'I don't know. It just went dead.' He withholds nothing because he has nothing to withhold, and lets the confusion show as bewilderment rather than alarm.
minds.basis: Trinity says 'You first, Neo,' handing him the phone; he answers on the CLICK and finds only silence; when asked 'What happened?' he answers 'I don't know,' which is a genuine report of not understanding rather than evasion.

believes_about.belief: That she will know what a dead line means and will take over, since she is the one who directs him.
believes_about.wrong_because: She doesn't actually know the specific cause either — the uncertainty note flags it may be Cypher's attack, which neither of them can see from here; she only knows enough to stop relying on the line and switch to the cellular.

believes_about.belief: That answering the phone was a simple, safe procedural step.
believes_about.wrong_because: Inferred: the dead line is the first sign that their world has been breached (Cypher / the raid), so the routine exit has already become dangerous — something Neo has no framework yet to read.

minds.wants: To regain control of an exit that has just stopped behaving the way it should — to get them out despite the line dying under her watch.
minds.feels: A veteran's snap into threat-assessment: the dead line is not a malfunction to be puzzled over but a signal that something has gone wrong on the ship, and she moves to a contingency rather than linger in confusion.
minds.shows: She asks 'What happened?' and then, getting no useful answer, simply listens to the dead line herself and reaches for the cellular — calm, economical, no visible alarm to feed Neo's uncertainty.
minds.basis: She directs Neo to the phone ('You first'), asks what happened, then rather than repeating his confusion she listens to the line and immediately takes out the cellular to act — the change-of-condition fact shows her shifting from waiting to doing.

believes_about.belief: That he is still too new to read a dead line as danger and must be guided rather than expected to diagnose it.
believes_about.wrong_because: Not wrong on the facts — he genuinely doesn't understand — but it fixes him in her mind as the one to be managed, the dynamic the rescue (ev-026 onward) will begin to overturn.

believes_about.belief: That she can still handle whatever this is by switching to the cellular, i.e. that the problem is local to the line.
believes_about.wrong_because: Inferred: the cause is the betrayal/attack on the Nebuchadnezzar, which the cellular cannot solve and which is about to force the much larger decision of whether to go back for Morpheus.

connects_back: sc-136: the PHONE begins RINGING in the shop, the exit call the crew is crawling toward.
sc-137: Cypher fires the lightning rifle at Tank on the Main Deck — the likely cause of the line going dead, which neither character in the shop can see.
sc-135: Tank loading the exit program, establishing the exit line as the mechanism that has now failed.
sets_up: ev-024: the crew learning the ship has been attacked (Tank injured, Dozer dead) and debating Morpheus's fate.
ev-026: the decision to re-enter the Matrix to rescue Morpheus rather than unplug him.
The shift in which Neo stops being the one who needs the phone answered for him and becomes the one who insists on going back.
dramatic_function: It converts the crew's moment of relief into the first concrete sign that the exit — their way out — has been severed, moving the story off the track of a clean escape and onto the collision with Cypher's betrayal and the Morpheus rescue.
